title: PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENTIAL LEARNING
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 24 credits
description: Provides an opportunity for public health students to integrate and apply principles and concepts they have learned through their coursework to address real-world public health issues. Allows students to gain experience in areas that meet their professional goals and interests by completion of an experiential learning opportunity of the student’s choice, either an internship or community projects. Demonstrates a student’s ability to complete and assess the experience through a professional portfolio.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: H 419.
A minimum grade of C- is required in H 419.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
